title: Session Resource
description:
A session represents the complete lifecycle of a voice interaction initiated through the Voice API.

A session can contain one or more related call legs (for example, an original outbound call plus additional dials or transfers triggered by SVAML commands). 
Use the `calls` array to inspect all call legs associated with the session and `state` to determine whether the session is still ongoing or has reached a final state.

createTime.description: Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the session was created.

updateTime.description:
Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the session was last updated.

Omitted if no updates were performed on this session.

endTime.description:
Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the session ended.

Omitted for ongoing sessions.

callName.description:
The name identifying this call leg within the session, as assigned by the `callName` property in the `dial` command or in the SVAML response to an incoming call webhook.

Omitted for calls that were not assigned a name.

bridgeName.description: The name of the bridge the call belongs to. Omitted for calls not assigned to any bridge.

startTime.description: Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the call was created and call setup was initiated (start of the call attempt).

updateTime.description:
Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the call was last updated.

Omitted if no updates were performed on this call.

answerTime.description:
Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the call was answered.

Omitted if the call was not answered.

endTime.description:
Timestamp (RFC 3339) indicating when the call ended.

Omitted for ongoing calls.

callDurationSeconds.description: Duration of the call in seconds

callRate.description: The rate charged for this call, expressed as a monetary amount **per minute** in the specified currency.

callResourceUrl.description: Absolute URI to this call resource. Use this URL to retrieve the call details

callDirection.title: Call Direction
callDirection.description: Indicates the direction of the call.

x-enumDescriptions.INBOUND: A call initiated towards the Sinch Calling Platform.
x-enumDescriptions.OUTBOUND: A call initiated from the Sinch Calling Platform.

callHeaders.description: Custom headers to be sent in the call setup.

callReason.title: Call Reason
callReason.description:
Reason explaining **why** the call ended in the given `callResult`.

`callResult` describes **what** happened (state/outcome). `callReason` provides additional context about the
underlying cause (for example, who terminated the call, routing issues, or validation errors).

x-enumDescriptions.CALLER_HANGUP: The caller hung up the call.
x-enumDescriptions.CALLEE_HANGUP: The callee hung up the call.
x-enumDescriptions.MANAGER_HANGUP: The call was ended by the call manager.
x-enumDescriptions.DID_NOT_FOUND: The DID number was not found.
x-enumDescriptions.UNKNOWN_PRODUCT: The product associated with the call is unknown.
x-enumDescriptions.NO_MORE_ROUTES: There are no more routes to complete the call.
x-enumDescriptions.ERROR: An error occurred during the call.

callResult.title: Call Result
callResult.description:
The outcome/state of the call.

This field includes both **transitional** states (during call setup and execution) and **final** states (when the call has ended).

x-enumDescriptions.QUEUED: The call is queued for initiation. This is a transitional state.
x-enumDescriptions.INITIATED: The call is connecting but the recipient has not yet answered. This is a transitional state.
x-enumDescriptions.IN_PROGRESS: The call has been answered and is in progress. This is a transitional state.
x-enumDescriptions.COMPLETED: The call was answered and is ended. This is a final state.
x-enumDescriptions.REJECTED: The call was rejected by the recipient.
x-enumDescriptions.NO_ANSWER: The call was not answered by the recipient.
x-enumDescriptions.BUSY: The call was not answered because the recipient was busy.
x-enumDescriptions.FAILED: The call could not be completed.

callType.title: Call Type
callType.description:
The type of channel used for the call.

This value indicates what kind of endpoint the call is connected to (PSTN phone number or WebSocket stream).

x-enumDescriptions.PHONE: A call from or to the telephone network.
x-enumDescriptions.SIP: A call from or to a SIP endpoint.
x-enumDescriptions.VOICE_RELAY: A call to voice relay service.

from.description: Call origin - Phone Number or SIP endpoint

money.title: Money
money.description: A monetary amount with an associated currency code.

amount.description: The monetary amount as a string to preserve precision. Supports up to 4 decimal places (e.g., "10.5000", "0.9999").

originationType.title: Origination Type
originationType.description:
Indicates the origin/source of the call.

This describes **how the call was initiated** (PSTN or via the API).

x-enumDescriptions.PHONE: The call originated from the telephone network (PSTN).
x-enumDescriptions.SIP: The call originated from a SIP trunk.
x-enumDescriptions.SERVER: The call originated through the Sinch API.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Routes the call to a phone number on the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN).

type.description: Routes the call to a phone number on the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN). The number must be in E.164 format.

projectId.title: Project ID
projectId.description: The `Id` of the project associated with the call.

serviceId.title: Service ID
serviceId.description: The ID of the service used.

sessionStates.title: Session States
sessionStates.description: The state of the current session. Sessions can either be in a "transitional" or "final" state.  Sessions in a transitional state are ongoing. Sessions in a final state have will not send any  more events.

x-enumDescriptions.QUEUED: The session is queued, no calls have been initiated for this session. This is a transitional state.
x-enumDescriptions.IN_PROGRESS: At least one call has been initiated or received for this session. This is a transitional state.
x-enumDescriptions.COMPLETED: The session was completed. This is a final state.
x-enumDescriptions.EXPIRED: The call session was not initiated before the batch time-to-live (TTL) elapsed. This is a final state.

type.description: Routes the call to a SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) endpoint.

endpoint.description: SIP URI of the destination endpoint. Both `sip:` (unencrypted) and `sips:` (TLS-encrypted) schemes are supported.

transport.description:
Transport protocol to use for the SIP signalling channel.

If omitted, the platform selects a default based on the URI scheme: `UDP` for `sip:` and `TLS` for `sips:`. Setting this explicitly overrides that default — for example, to force `TCP` for a `sip:` URI or to use `TLS` without switching to the `sips:` scheme.

x-enumDescriptions.UDP: Connectionless transport. Lowest overhead; suitable for most standard SIP deployments.
x-enumDescriptions.TCP: Connection-oriented transport. More reliable for large SIP messages or NAT traversal scenarios.
x-enumDescriptions.TLS: Encrypted transport. Provides confidentiality and integrity for SIP signalling.

sipCallHeaders.description: Custom SIP headers to be sent in the call setup.

type.description: Indicates the call originated from a SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) endpoint.

endpoint.description: SIP URI of the originating endpoint. Both `sip:` (unencrypted) and `sips:` (TLS-encrypted) schemes are supported.

displayName.description: Display name presented to the called party as the caller identity. Transmitted as the display name part of the SIP `From` header (for example, `Alice <sip:alice@example.com>`).

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Routes the call to a WebSocket stream endpoint for real-time audio processing.

type.description: Routes the call to a WebSocket stream endpoint for real-time audio processing.

endpoint.description: WebSocket endpoint that will accept the incoming connection for real-time audio streaming. Must be a valid WebSocket URL using either `ws://` or `wss://` (recommended). The URL must be reachable from the public internet and capable of handling the negotiated stream protocol.

version.description: Defines the version of the stream protocol.

codec.description:
Defines the audio codec/format used for the stream audio payload.

Currently, only `PCM` is supported (uncompressed raw audio). Use `sampleRate` to configure the sampling rate for the stream.

sampleRate.description:
Defines the audio sampling rate (Hz) used for the stream.

For calls that traverse the PSTN, audio is typically sampled at 8 kHz, so using a higher value will not improve perceived quality. 
Higher sample rates can be useful for non-PSTN scenarios (for example, SIP/streaming paths), but will increase bandwidth usage and processing load.

to.title: To
to.description: Call destination - Phone Number or Stream URI

voiceName.description: Sinch Voice Name to use for text-to-speech. Each voice is tied to a specific language variant, gender, and pricing model (Free/Standard or Paid/Generative). See [https://developers.sinch.com/docs/voice-2.0/api-reference/text-to-speech-voices#text-to-speech-voices](https://developers.sinch.com/docs/voice-2.0/api-reference/text-to-speech-voices#currently-available-languages) for details

voiceRelay.title: Voice Relay
voiceRelay.description: Routes the call through the Voice Relay service, enabling real-time speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) via a WebSocket connection to the application backend.

type.description: Connects to the Voice Relay service to enable STT and TTS services...

endpoint.description: URL to the server that will accept the web-socket request

enableInterruptions.description:
Allow "barge-in" during text-to-speech (TTS) playback.

When `true`, TTS playback is interrupted as soon as inbound speech is detected, unless the currently playing content is marked as uninterruptible.

When `false`, TTS playback continues uninterrupted, but an interruption signal is still sent over the WebSocket so the client application can choose to stop playback manually if needed.

ttsVoice.description:
Name of the voice to be used when synthesizing speech. 

This is the default voice used, if no override voice is provided in the web-socket TTS message.

sttLanguage.description:
BCP-47 language tag used for speech-to-text transcription of the inbound audio.

This value determines which language model is used for transcription.
